text:
sara (AM): Quick shoutout — we closed EmberCare! :tada: They signed a 12mo Private + ISV co-sell agreement, moving their telehealth triage models to Redwood Private for HIPAA workloads.

anika (SE): Amazing news — they picked our VPC private control plane + managed KV cache. Did the final bake on latency targets yesterday.

matt (Sales): Huge credit to @sara and @anika for the demo run. Contract signed this morning, CFO asked for an accelerated onboarding checklist.

jordan (CS): Onboarding plan uploaded: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/embercare-onboard (permissions: redwood/partners/embercare). Key items: SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, network peering doc.

alex (Product): Nice! We're also listing EmberCare as an ISV integration — marketing wants a short case blurb. Can someone share 2–3 bullet wins (latency, cost delta, compliance)?

anika (SE): 2 bullets for case: "consistently <120ms 95p for 256-token triage flows" and "~35% reduction in per-token infra cost via prefix caching + batching".

sara (AM): I'll draft the customer quote request and loop legal for approval. Also filing a marketplace listing ticket.

ops-bot: Billing record created for account embercare-corp; plan=private-annual-12mo; seat_count=1. (ticket #BR-4521)

matt (Sales): Next steps: 1) kickoff call w/ EmberCare engineers (Mon 09:30 PT) 2) network peering window (week of 4/6) 3) marketing case draft due EOW.

jordan (CS): I'll run the kickoff and bring SE, infra, and security. Prep note: share the `onboard checklist` in #eng-ops before the call.

anika (SE): Posting a tiny snippet they can run in their env for connectivity test:
```
# verify VPC peering
curl -sS https://internal.redwood.test/healthz -H "Authorization: Bearer <redwood-token>"
```

sara (AM): Love it. One more thing — this is a co-sell with our MSP partner OrbitCloud, they'll handle part of the network setup. OrbitCloud contact: rachel@orbitcloud.io. :sparkles:

matt (Sales): Congrats team — big enterprise reference potential in healthcare. Please add any blockers here and I'll escalate.

alex (Product): Could we capture an initial success metric in the kickoff? e.g., baseline triage latency and first-week throughput. I'll add a telemetry dashboard template.

jordan (CS): Will do. Adding `embercare-kickoff` to calendar and creating a #embercare-onboard channel post-kickoff.

sara (AM): Thanks all — celebratory donuts next week for the SF office? :doughnut: :celebrate: 

matt (Sales): Donuts = yes. :thumbsup:

(reacted :tada: by anika (SE), sara (AM), matt (Sales))
